attachments.origin_landmark: external ilium, between anterior and posterior gluteal lines, below iliac crest

actions: stabilizes pelvis in single-leg stance (prevents contralateral pelvic drop -- Trendelenburg mechanism)
anterior fibers internally rotate, posterior fibers externally rotate hip

functional_compartments.name: Anterior segment
functional_compartments.function_note: Assists hip flexion + internal rotation in addition to abduction; documented separately-recruitable EMG compartment.
functional_compartments.source: Gottschalk F, Kourosh S, Leveau B (1989) J Anat 166:179-189 -- 'The functional anatomy of tensor fasciae latae and gluteus medius and minimus'; explicitly describes gluteus medius's three functionally-graded parts

functional_compartments.name: Middle segment
functional_compartments.function_note: Purest abductor line of pull, largest PCSA segment.
functional_compartments.source: Gottschalk F, Kourosh S, Leveau B (1989) J Anat 166:179-189 -- 'The functional anatomy of tensor fasciae latae and gluteus medius and minimus'; explicitly describes gluteus medius's three functionally-graded parts

functional_compartments.name: Posterior segment
functional_compartments.function_note: Assists hip extension + external rotation in addition to abduction.
functional_compartments.source: Gottschalk F, Kourosh S, Leveau B (1989) J Anat 166:179-189 -- 'The functional anatomy of tensor fasciae latae and gluteus medius and minimus'; explicitly describes gluteus medius's three functionally-graded parts

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Gottschalk F, Kourosh S, Leveau B (1989) J Anat 166:179-189
